name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
title: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd - 532209 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Record FY26 PAT of INR2,363 cr (+13.5%) with GNPA 2.50% and zero-ish credit cost, but NIM fell to 3.60% and FY27 guidance is conservative (NIM ~3.5%, credit growth 12%, GNPA <2.25%).

triggers.label: FY27 NIM guided ~3.5% vs 3.60% FY26
triggers.quote: NIM around 3.5%, RoA - maintain around the current levels, RoE around 16%, and Gross NPA below 2.25%

triggers.label: Yield on advances fell with rate cuts
triggers.quote: Yield has decreased on account of the repo rate cut that has happened in the last financial year.

triggers.label: SMA book down to 12.07% from 22.33%
triggers.quote: which has come down to INR14,724 crores, that is 12.07% of the advances

triggers.label: Credit growth FY26 16.8% on advances
triggers.quote: deposits and gross advances growing at 11.3% and 16.8% respectively

guidance.quote: credit growth of 12%, deposit growth of 10%, CASA at 45%
deposit growth of 10%, CASA at 45%, NIM around 3.5%
NIM around 3.5%, RoA - maintain around the current levels
RoE around 16%, and Gross NPA below 2.25%
the credit cost will be somewhere around say 0.1% or 0.2% maximum, not more than that

guidance.value: around INR500 crore for next two quarters
guidance.quote: At least for the next two quarters, I am certain that it will be around that.

guidance.value: cross INR5 lakh crore in three years
guidance.quote: we aim to cross INR5 lakh crores by then

prior_guidance_check.quote: The only exception has been a marginal shortfall in the NIM, where we have fallen short of our guidance.
both comfortably exceeding our guidance for the financial year
both comfortably exceeding our guidance for the financial year
we have also surpassed our guided RoA and R oE levels, with RoA and RoE of 1.37% and 16.85%

red_flags.label: Q4 employee cost helped by INR153 cr one-off reversal
red_flags.quote: there was a reversal of INR153 crores in Q4. That was on account of discount rate change in retirement benefits.

red_flags.label: Q4 technical write-offs in trade book
red_flags.quote: a bit of it also would be technical write -off that we have done in the last quarter

red_flags.label: Gramin Bank EDB impairment INR180 cr hit other income
red_flags.quote: we had to make an impairment of INR180 crores on account of this amalgamation

evasions.quote: I am unable to assess a credit cost which is more than 1% in the next three to four years.
it will not be very accurate if I say what kind of provisioning this bank will have to make for the period of five years.
